facts.fact: The OQSF-BF, housed in the state agency ANPFI, mediates free of charge disputes with banks, microfinance institutions, insurers and e-money issuers, and says it has handled more than 220 cases since 2022 with about 92% settled amicably.
facts.system: Observatoire de la qualité des services financiers (OQSF-BF)

note: Case count covers all financial services, so not an enforcement figure.
